summary: Hawshaw Mountain lookout, Avery County: CCC-built 45 ft 9 in tower and cabin in 1934; a 2008 blog said still standing, not publicly accessible; a 180 ft lattice tower registered to the NC State Highway Patrol is recorded at the address today.

notes_for_editor: Build year and size come from Forest Lookouts (one compiled list that cites a 1940 state report); the blog (June 2008) matches the 1934 date. Fate and access rest on the 2008 blog, which summarizes Peter Barr's 2008 guidebook, so they are dated and no later source confirms them. The access level 'restricted' is our reading of 'not publically accessible'. The FCC record ASR-1326159 (180 ft lattice, registered to NC State Highway Patrol, status Constructed) sits within a few dozen metres of the state list point, but no source says whether it is the old lookout, a newer structure, or separate; this is not resolved. The Avery History Hunters Facebook posts could not be read beyond their titles and are not used. The FOX8 report was checked and dropped as not specific to Hawshaw. Brief status 'unknown' should move to 'standing per 2008 source, unconfirmed'; no status key set. Height_m is converted from 45 ft 9 in.
